scenes.narration: Debuting with the latest generation in 2023, the BMW 760i xDrive is the brand’s flagship luxury sedan.

Under the hood, it packs a 4.4-liter twin-turbo V8, combined with a 48-volt hybrid system, offering 553 lb-ft of torque. It goes from zero to sixty in just 3.9 seconds. It's the same engine in the M850i.
Power is sent to all four wheels through an 8-speed automatic transmission, ensuring exceptional control.
The M Sport Professional package is an option at $110K, adding M Sport brakes for enhanced performance. Priced at $110K, it's a serious investment in luxury. This generation started in 2023.
Inside, Rear Executive Lounge Seating delivers unmatched comfort with reclining seats and entertainment systems.
Given its hybrid power and luxury, is the 760i xDrive the ultimate blend of performance and sophistication for you?

sections.Highlights: THIS... is a 2026 BMW 760i xDrive, finished in Frozen Deep Grey with a black interior. The attached Carfax vehicle history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this 760i’s brief past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes the Executive, Autobahn, and M Sport Professional packages, Rear Executive Lounge Seating, BMW Individual Composition, 21-inch Individual multi-spoke wheels, and a Bowers & Wilkins Diamond surround sound system. The selling dealer reports no notable modifications. The latest generation 7 Series debuted for the 2023 model year, representing BMW's flagship luxury sedan with advanced technology and performance features. The 760i xDrive is powered by a mild-hybrid V8 engine and features all-wheel drive, offering a blend of dynamic driving and comfort. As the top-tier model in the 7 Series lineup, it showcases BMW's latest innovations in design, safety, and in-cabin technology. Power comes from a 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8 and a 48-volt hybrid system, rated at 536 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission and BMW's xDrive permanent all-wheel drive system.
sections.Equipment: A window sticker is provided in the photo gallery, and a partial list of notable equipment reported by the selling dealer includes: Executive Package (crystal headlights, automatic doors, Parking Assistant Professional, illuminated kidney grille, Park View with 3D View, Driving Assistant Plus) Rear Executive Lounge Seating (electric reclining seat and footrest, rear-seat Entertainment Professional, executive lounge rear center console) BMW Individual Composition (full Merino leather upholstery, carbon fiber trim with silver thread and Piano Black accents, Alcantara headliner) Autobahn Package (active roll stabilization, Active Comfort Drive with road preview) M Sport Professional Package (M Sport brakes with black calipers, extended Shadowline trim, rear spoiler) 21-inch Individual multi-spoke wheels Bowers & Wilkins Diamond surround sound system
sections.Seller Notes: The selling dealer reports that the windows have been tinted. The selling dealer will collect sales tax from Texas buyers.
